entries.title: Binary Black Hole Dance
entries.description: Two dark spheres with glowing accretion disks orbit each other while colored particle streams spiral in, merge, and emit pulsing “gravitational wave” rings that expand outward and fade.
entries.seed: Binary Black Hole Dance: Two dark spheres with glowing accretion disks orbit each other while colored particle streams spiral in, merge, and emit pulsing “gravitational wave” rings that expand outward and fade.

entries.title: Star Falling into a Black Hole
entries.description: A bright star orbits a central black hole, getting stretched into a glowing tidal “spaghetti” stream that wraps around, collides with itself, and forms a hot, swirling accretion disk with flickering particle jets.
entries.seed: Star Falling into a Black Hole: A bright star orbits a central black hole, getting stretched into a glowing tidal “spaghetti” stream that wraps around, collides with itself, and forms a hot, swirling accretion disk with flickering particle jets.

entries.title: Accretion Disk with Test Particles
entries.description: Hundreds of small colored spheres orbit a central black hole, forming a flat disk where particles collide, stick, or scatter, leaving faint trails while some spiral inward and vanish at the event horizon.
entries.seed: Accretion Disk with Test Particles: Hundreds of small colored spheres orbit a central black hole, forming a flat disk where particles collide, stick, or scatter, leaving faint trails while some spiral inward and vanish at the event horizon.

entries.title: Gravitational Lensing of Background Grid
entries.description: A transparent grid of light rays and distant stars sits behind a central black hole, and as the camera orbits, the grid and stars warp and bend around the black hole, with curved light paths drawn as glowing arcs.
entries.seed: Gravitational Lensing of Background Grid: A transparent grid of light rays and distant stars sits behind a central black hole, and as the camera orbits, the grid and stars warp and bend around the black hole, with curved light paths drawn as glowing arcs.

entries.title: Black Hole and Orbiting Planetary System
entries.description: A black hole at the center pulls on a small planetary system: planets with trails follow distorted, precessing orbits, occasionally slingshotting away or spiraling inward and disappearing with a flash.
entries.seed: Black Hole and Orbiting Planetary System: A black hole at the center pulls on a small planetary system: planets with trails follow distorted, precessing orbits, occasionally slingshotting away or spiraling inward and disappearing with a flash.

entries.title: Matter Jet Emission from Spinning Black Hole
entries.description: A rapidly rotating black hole with a bright, thin accretion disk launches two narrow particle jets along its spin axis, where particles accelerate, collide, branch, and slowly fade while the disk glows and thickens.
entries.seed: Matter Jet Emission from Spinning Black Hole: A rapidly rotating black hole with a bright, thin accretion disk launches two narrow particle jets along its spin axis, where particles accelerate, collide, branch, and slowly fade while the disk glows and thickens.

entries.title: Three-Body Chaos with a Black Hole
entries.description: A black hole and two stars move in 3D, gravitationally tugging each other; trajectories twist chaotically with colored trails, sometimes ejecting one star while the other gets captured or swallowed.
entries.seed: Three-Body Chaos with a Black Hole: A black hole and two stars move in 3D, gravitationally tugging each other; trajectories twist chaotically with colored trails, sometimes ejecting one star while the other gets captured or swallowed.

entries.title: Black Hole Swallowing a Gas Cloud
entries.description: A semi-transparent colored gas blob drifts toward a black hole, stretches, splits into streamers, and wraps into a clumpy ring where segments collide, merge, and gradually transfer mass into the black hole.
entries.seed: Black Hole Swallowing a Gas Cloud: A semi-transparent colored gas blob drifts toward a black hole, stretches, splits into streamers, and wraps into a clumpy ring where segments collide, merge, and gradually transfer mass into the black hole.

entries.title: Black Hole Cluster in a Star Field
entries.description: Several black holes drift within a sparse star cluster; stars orbit, get captured, or slingshot between them, while merging black holes combine into larger ones with changing labels and glow intensity.
entries.seed: Black Hole Cluster in a Star Field: Several black holes drift within a sparse star cluster; stars orbit, get captured, or slingshot between them, while merging black holes combine into larger ones with changing labels and glow intensity.

entries.title: Miniature “Black Hole” Marble Experiment
entries.description: Small “marble” spheres roll on a shallow funnel surface that slopes into a central hole, orbiting, bouncing, and spiraling inward, with trails that reveal their decaying orbits and collisions.
entries.seed: Miniature “Black Hole” Marble Experiment: Small “marble” spheres roll on a shallow funnel surface that slopes into a central hole, orbiting, bouncing, and spiraling inward, with trails that reveal their decaying orbits and collisions.

entries.title: Black Hole Mass Growth Meter
entries.description: A single black hole sits in the center while multicolored particles fall in from random directions; each swallowed particle slightly enlarges the black hole and raises a floating mass bar and numeric label.
entries.seed: Black Hole Mass Growth Meter: A single black hole sits in the center while multicolored particles fall in from random directions; each swallowed particle slightly enlarges the black hole and raises a floating mass bar and numeric label.

entries.title: Tidal Disruption of a Binary Star Pair
entries.description: A close pair of orbiting stars approaches a black hole; their orbits stretch and twist, one star is captured and shredded into a stream, while the other escapes with a new, bent trajectory and a fading trail.
entries.seed: Tidal Disruption of a Binary Star Pair: A close pair of orbiting stars approaches a black hole; their orbits stretch and twist, one star is captured and shredded into a stream, while the other escapes with a new, bent trajectory and a fading trail.

entries.title: Black Hole + Magnetic Field Lines
entries.description: A spinning black hole is surrounded by arcing, glowing magnetic field lines represented as looping tubes; charged particles slide along these tubes, spiral, and get ejected in structured jets.
entries.seed: Black Hole + Magnetic Field Lines: A spinning black hole is surrounded by arcing, glowing magnetic field lines represented as looping tubes; charged particles slide along these tubes, spiral, and get ejected in structured jets.

entries.title: Multi-Scale Galaxy Core with Central Black Hole
entries.description: A transparent galactic disk of stars orbits a bright core containing a black hole; inner stars move faster on warped paths, occasionally colliding or being pulled inward, with color-coded orbital speeds.
entries.seed: Multi-Scale Galaxy Core with Central Black Hole: A transparent galactic disk of stars orbits a bright core containing a black hole; inner stars move faster on warped paths, occasionally colliding or being pulled inward, with color-coded orbital speeds.

entries.title: Black Hole as a Gravity Well on a Flexible Grid
entries.description: A light-colored elastic grid deforms under a central mass; small balls roll and orbit along the curved surface, with the grid dynamically dipping more as additional mass attaches to the central object.
entries.seed: Black Hole as a Gravity Well on a Flexible Grid: A light-colored elastic grid deforms under a central mass; small balls roll and orbit along the curved surface, with the grid dynamically dipping more as additional mass attaches to the central object.

entries.title: Black Hole Evaporation Visualization
entries.description: A small black hole slowly shrinks over time while emitting tiny, colored particle bursts in all directions; a size label and lifetime bar decrease as more particles escape instead of falling back.
entries.seed: Black Hole Evaporation Visualization: A small black hole slowly shrinks over time while emitting tiny, colored particle bursts in all directions; a size label and lifetime bar decrease as more particles escape instead of falling back.

entries.title: Accretion Disk Instability and Ring Breakup
entries.description: A smooth ring of particles around a black hole develops clumps that grow, collide, and split; sections of the ring detach and form spiral arms that either fall in or escape as arcs of particles.
entries.seed: Accretion Disk Instability and Ring Breakup: A smooth ring of particles around a black hole develops clumps that grow, collide, and split; sections of the ring detach and form spiral arms that either fall in or escape as arcs of particles.

entries.title: Black Hole and Photon Orbits
entries.description: Streams of light-like particles approach a black hole from different angles; some skim, curve, and escape, others enter a tight photon ring orbit before spiraling in, with curved paths drawn as glowing trails.
entries.seed: Black Hole and Photon Orbits: Streams of light-like particles approach a black hole from different angles; some skim, curve, and escape, others enter a tight photon ring orbit before spiraling in, with curved paths drawn as glowing trails.

entries.title: Educational Black Hole Cross-Section
entries.description: A cutaway 3D sphere shows layers: event horizon, ergosphere, and singularity; labeled, semi-transparent shells rotate slowly while colored test particles demonstrate which regions allow escape or capture.
entries.seed: Educational Black Hole Cross-Section: A cutaway 3D sphere shows layers: event horizon, ergosphere, and singularity; labeled, semi-transparent shells rotate slowly while colored test particles demonstrate which regions allow escape or capture.

entries.title: Black Hole Feeding from a Companion Star
entries.description: A star and a black hole orbit a shared center; gas gently pulls off the star’s surface, forming a spiraling transfer stream that wraps into a small disk around the black hole, with mass transfer rate shown on a gauge.

entries.title: Black Hole Merger in a Starry Background
entries.description: Two black holes with small disks slowly spiral together, their orbits shrinking while they emit expanding, rippling rings; at merger, they form one larger black hole whose spin axis reorients and jets realign.

entries.title: Particle Fountain Near a Micro Black Hole
entries.description: A tiny central black hole levitates above a platform; colored particles are sprayed upward like a fountain and either escape, bounce off a transparent “lab” dome, or get deflected and swallowed by the black hole.

entries.description: Data-cube objects with binary-texture surfaces float toward a dark “information hole” box; cubes entering dissolve into colored particles while a side panel tracks “in” vs. “recovered” information counts.

entries.description: Rock fragments and metal chunks orbit a black hole in a thick debris ring, colliding, bouncing, and sometimes sticking into larger clumps that migrate inward or outward depending on repeated impacts.

2. **Star Falling into a Black Hole**
